items.exampleEn: Bake the bread in the oven for thirty minutes.
items.exampleZh: 把麵包放進烤箱烤三十分鐘。

items.exampleEn: My phone needs a new battery.
items.exampleZh: 我的手機需要換新電池。

items.exampleEn: Our garage is big enough for two cars.
items.exampleZh: 我們的車庫大到可以停兩台車。

items.exampleEn: She put the apples in a basket.
It's cold. Do you need another blanket?
items.exampleZh: 好冷，你要不要再多拿一條毯子？

items.exampleEn: This container is made of glass.
There are two elevators in this building.
There is a small lamp next to my bed.
Put the milk back in the refrigerator.

items.sentenceEn: The elevator is not working today.

items.audioEn: The batteries are in the basket next to the refrigerator.
items.audioZh: 電池放在冰箱旁邊的籃子裡。

items.sentenceEn: My cat sleeps on a warm blanket.
items.sentenceZh: 我的貓睡在一條溫暖的毯子上。

items.sentenceEn: We keep our bikes in the garage.
items.sentenceZh: 我們把腳踏車放在車庫裡。

items.stemEn: The cake is still in the ____. It needs ten more minutes.
items.stemZh: 蛋糕還在烤箱裡，還要再烤十分鐘。

items.stemEn: I put a new ____ in the clock, and now it works again.
items.stemZh: 我在時鐘裡放了一顆新電池，現在它又會走了。

items.passageEn: Last week, Kevin and his wife moved into a new apartment on the eleventh floor, so they take the elevator every day. The kitchen has a big refrigerator and an oven. There is no garage, so they park their car on the street. Kevin's mother gave them a basket of fruit, a warm blanket and a lamp for the living room.
items.passageZh: 上週，Kevin 和太太搬進一間位在十一樓的新公寓，所以他們每天都搭電梯。廚房裡有一台大冰箱和一個烤箱。那裡沒有車庫，所以他們把車停在街上。Kevin 的媽媽送了他們一籃水果、一條溫暖的毯子和一盞放客廳的燈。

items.promptZh: 請把湯倒進這個容器裡。
referenceEn: Please pour the soup into this container.
Please put the soup in this container.
rubricZh: 「倒進」可寫例如 pour … into、put … in
請求句用原形動詞開頭（例如 Please pour…）

items.instructionZh: 用 refrigerator 造一個句子，說說你家冰箱裡有什麼。
referenceEn: There are some eggs and fruit in our refrigerator.
Our refrigerator is full of vegetables.
rubricZh: refrigerator 是可數名詞（例如 the refrigerator、our refrigerator）
「在冰箱裡」用 in（例如 in our refrigerator）；說「裝滿了」可寫 is full of
